arStrings.szText: "I did, Tharra. But 'Akarat' did not."
To think, I thought so little of you that day in Temis! Yet here you stand—the maddest bastard I've ever known.
PLAYER LEAD IN LINE: “I did, Tharra. But ‘Akarat’ did not.”  -- Tharra is proud and relieved. She realizes we have defeated the great evil that threatened Skovos.
What became of Akarat—Mephisto? Just before the Temple sank, we heard a terrible scream, loud enough to stir the dead. Is he gone?
Curious
Banished. Beyond the reach of this world or any other. But those who served him remain to be reckoned with.
What say you, Amazons? Shall we reckon with them?
(chant in unison)
Strong, fierce, proud. Like a single phrase from a Maori "Haka."
You have our answer. What is yours?
Speaking to the Player character
“In victory, give honor to your dead...”
Repeating a quote that Tharra said earlier in the story.
I will continue to fight, as Lorath would have...but not while his soul suffers.
I must go to the Tree of Whispers and grant him the rest he deserves—with a torch in my hand.
Determined
Burn the Tree of Whispers... Heh. It is a stunt Lorath himself might have attempted, were we in his place.
Mulling over the idea. Admiring the audacity of it. Player is suggesting they break the hand of fate.
But it will take more than common fire to see it done properly. Meet me at the Tree.
Determined
